## 1. Executive Summary, CAC Incorporation Particulars & Governance Framework

**Eniolajun Global Integrated Services Ltd** is an active, duly incorporated Nigerian corporate entity registered with the **Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC) under Registration Number RC 1441429**, established to bring transparency, engineering rigor, and structural longevity to property and facility management.

Headquartered at **No. 12, Liberty Drive, Off Alcon Road, Woji, Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria** ([View on Google Maps](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=No.+12+Liberty+Drive+Off+Alcon+Road+Woji+Port+Harcourt+Rivers+State+Nigeria)), and providing operational management across **Port Harcourt, Lagos, Abuja**, and surrounding hubs, we manage residential gated communities, commercial complexes, and industrial facilities.

### Official CAC Incorporation Particulars
- **Registered Legal Name:** ENIOLAJUN GLOBAL INTEGRATED SERVICES LIMITED
- **Trading Name:** Eniolajun Global Integrated Services Ltd

- **Entity Classification:** Private Company Limited by Shares (Ltd)

### Professional Delivery & Regulatory Compliance Disclosure
Our multidisciplinary delivery model unites dedicated property administrators, facility managers, and tenant relations professionals, working alongside accredited partner Estate Surveyors and Valuers, legal practitioners, and COREN-certified mechanical/electrical (MEP) engineers. Where client engagements require statutory valuation reports, legal title perfection/conveyancing, or regulated engineering sign-offs, execution is formally coordinated with the respective licensed professionals in accordance with Nigerian law.

### Strategic Vision
To become a dependable and respected real estate and integrated facilities management brand in West Africa, recognized for unwavering integrity, proactive engineering solutions, and long-term value preservation for property owners.

### Corporate Mission
To maximize our clients' return on investment through systematic estate governance, transparent financial reporting, rapid-response preventative maintenance, and continuous optimization of utilities, assets, and living environments.

### Four Pillars of Operational Excellence
1. **Fiduciary Transparency:** Designated client bank accounts, monthly audited balance sheets, and itemized reconciliation for all service charges, vendor invoices, procurement receipts, and diesel supplies.
2. **Rapid Emergency Dispatch (< 2 Hours Target):** Prompt on-site technical response for emergency generator faults, plumbing bursts, and access control breakdowns.
3. **Vetted Artisan Database:** Accredited database of qualified electricians, plumbers, HVAC specialists, and landscapers who undergo background and technical competency checks.
4. **Statutory & CAC Compliance (RC 1441429):** Duly incorporated with the Corporate Affairs Commission (RC 1441429), operating in full adherence to state urban planning laws, fire service certifications, Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA), and environmental regulations.

## 2. All 10 Core Services & Deliverables

### 01. Estate Management
- **Category:** Estate & Property
- **URL:** https://www.eniolajunglobalservices.com/services#estate-management
- **Summary:** Comprehensive administration and operational stewardship for residential estates and gated communities.
- **Full Description:** We provide structured operational management for residential and gated estates. From service charge budgeting and collection to security coordination, vendor oversight, and resident association liaison, our systems support seamless daily operations and harmonious community living.
- **Scope & Key Deliverables:**
  - Estate rules & governance administration
  - Service charge budgeting & transparent accounting
  - Access control, perimeter security & surveillance oversight
  - Common area janitorial & infrastructure maintenance
  - Resident association relationship management

### 02. Property Management and Administration
- **Category:** Estate & Property
- **URL:** https://www.eniolajunglobalservices.com/services#property-management
- **Summary:** End-to-end landlord and tenant administration designed to protect asset value and optimize occupancy.
- **Full Description:** Our property management service lifts the day-to-day operational burden off landlords. We oversee tenant vetting, tenancy documentation coordination, rent collection administration, dispute resolution, regular preventative inspections, and lease renewals.
- **Scope & Key Deliverables:**
  - Tenant screening & background verification
  - Tenancy agreement coordination with legal practitioners
  - Structured rent collection & financial reporting
  - Routine property inspections & condition audits
  - Prompt tenant query resolution & tenancy record-keeping

### 03. Property Sales
- **Category:** Estate & Property
- **URL:** https://www.eniolajunglobalservices.com/services#property-sales
- **Summary:** Strategic marketing, acquisition support, and verified disposition of residential and commercial real estate.
- **Full Description:** We connect buyers with vetted sellers of residential, commercial, and industrial properties. Our team coordinates due diligence with accredited legal and surveying partners, market positioning, buyer negotiations, and closing documentation with full transparency.
- **Scope & Key Deliverables:**
  - Title due diligence coordinated with legal & land registry partners
  - Targeted property marketing across investor networks
  - Guided private viewings & buyer negotiation support
  - Coordination of closing documentation & handover
  - Real estate portfolio acquisition advisory

### 04. Property Valuation and Consultancy
- **Category:** Consultancy
- **URL:** https://www.eniolajunglobalservices.com/services#property-valuation
- **Summary:** Market-grounded property appraisal coordination, feasibility studies, and strategic real estate advisory.
- **Full Description:** We deliver market-grounded real estate consultancy, rental yield analysis, and feasibility studies, while coordinating statutory and mortgage valuation reports in partnership with accredited Estate Surveyors and Valuers.
- **Scope & Key Deliverables:**
  - Property market appraisals & accredited valuation coordination
  - Rental yield analysis & commercial lease benchmarking
  - Feasibility studies & highest-and-best-use advisory
  - Pre-acquisition property condition & risk assessments
  - Portfolio performance & asset optimization consultancy

### 05. Facility Management
- **Category:** Facility Operations
- **URL:** https://www.eniolajunglobalservices.com/services#facility-management
- **Summary:** Integrated operational management ensuring corporate offices, complexes, and industrial sites run efficiently.
- **Full Description:** We harmonize people, workplace processes, and building infrastructure to optimize facility lifecycles. Our team oversees building services, health and safety compliance, energy management, and vendor SLAs so your organization can focus on its core business.
- **Scope & Key Deliverables:**
  - Total Facilities Management (TFM) contracts
  - Workplace Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) compliance
  - Service Level Agreement (SLA) vendor management
  - Space planning & occupancy coordination
  - Asset registers, lifecycle tracking & cost rationalization

### 06. Building Maintenance and Repairs
- **Category:** Maintenance & Engineering
- **URL:** https://www.eniolajunglobalservices.com/services#building-maintenance
- **Summary:** Rapid reactive repairs and planned preventative maintenance for plumbing, electrical, and structural systems.
- **Full Description:** A proactive approach to building health that mitigates costly emergency failures. Our vetted technical teams execute scheduled servicing and rapid-response repairs covering electrical panels, plumbing networks, roofs, facades, and carpentry.
- **Scope & Key Deliverables:**
  - Scheduled Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM)
  - On-call emergency maintenance & repair dispatch
  - Electrical troubleshooting, distribution boards & surge protection
  - Plumbing pipelines, water pumps & drainage clearing
  - Carpentry, masonry, painting & waterproofing

### 07. Estate Grounds and Landscaping Maintenance
- **Category:** Maintenance & Engineering
- **URL:** https://www.eniolajunglobalservices.com/services#grounds-and-landscaping

- **Scope & Key Deliverables:**
  - Lawn mowing, edging & seasonal turf management
  - Tree pruning, flower bed design & hedge shaping
  - Drainage de-silting & stormwater runoff clearance
  - Irrigation system maintenance & repairs
  - Eco-friendly weed control & exterior pest suppression

### 08. Property Inspection and Refurbishment
- **Category:** Maintenance & Engineering
- **URL:** https://www.eniolajunglobalservices.com/services#property-inspection-refurbishment
- **Summary:** Thorough structural condition audits and modern interior/exterior architectural makeovers.
- **Full Description:** Before acquisition, tenancy handover, or major renovations, our detailed condition audits identify defects, moisture ingress, and electrical/plumbing issues. We also manage complete interior and exterior refurbishments that restore and enhance property value.
- **Scope & Key Deliverables:**
  - Comprehensive pre-purchase & pre-lease snagging audits
  - Building defect diagnosis & dampness assessments
  - Interior modernization (flooring, ceilings, lighting, cabinetry)
  - Exterior facade restoration & protective painting
  - Turnkey refurbishment project management within agreed budgets

### 09. Facility Installations and Coordination
- **Category:** Facility Operations
- **URL:** https://www.eniolajunglobalservices.com/services#facility-installations-coordination
- **Summary:** Project coordination, installation, and testing of building infrastructure, power systems, and security equipment.
- **Full Description:** We coordinate the specification, procurement, installation, and commissioning of essential facility assets with accredited OEM and engineering specialists—from commercial generator setups and solar inverter systems to CCTV networks and access control.
- **Scope & Key Deliverables:**
  - Commercial generator & solar inverter installation coordination
  - CCTV surveillance, biometric access & perimeter security systems
  - Water filtration, booster pumps & reservoir tank setups
  - Fire alarm systems, smoke detectors & suppression equipment
  - Testing, commissioning & OEM warranty coordination

### 10. Utilities and Facilities Operations Management
- **Category:** Facility Operations
- **URL:** https://www.eniolajunglobalservices.com/services#utilities-operations-management
- **Summary:** Continuous oversight of central power distribution, water treatment plants, waste logistics, and energy budgeting.
- **Full Description:** Uninterrupted power, clean water, and disciplined waste logistics are essential to any modern Nigerian facility. We manage diesel supply auditing, utility vendor contracts, borehole water treatment operations, and energy metering to optimize operating costs.
- **Scope & Key Deliverables:**
  - Power generation scheduling & diesel fuel quality auditing
  - Borehole & central water treatment plant operations
  - Solid & liquid waste management logistics
  - Utility metering, sub-metering & cost recovery administration
  - Energy consumption audits & operating cost optimization

## 3. Representative Portfolio & Managed Asset Profiles

1. **Crown Crest Residential Estate** — *Old GRA, Port Harcourt* (`Estate Management`)
   - **Scope:** Complete estate governance, 24/7 security oversight, water plant maintenance, and service charge administration for a multi-unit residential community.
   - **Outcome:** Streamlined transparent service charge reconciliation and maintained continuous operational uptime for water and gate security systems.

2. **Meridian Commercial Complex** — *Trans-Amadi, Port Harcourt* (`Facility Operations`)
   - **Scope:** Integrated total facilities management, backup generator servicing, HVAC central chiller maintenance, and janitorial services for corporate tenants.
   - **Outcome:** Optimized generator load scheduling and smart energy sub-metering to lower operating fuel overhead for commercial occupants.

3. **Oakwood Residences Refurbishment** — *Peter Odili Road, Port Harcourt* (`Property Inspection & Refurbishment`)
   - **Scope:** Pre-purchase structural snagging audit, complete exterior facade repainting, plumbing re-piping, and modern interior kitchen remodels.
   - **Outcome:** Restored structural integrity, resolved dampness ingress, and positioned the asset for premium residential leasing.

4. **Sovereign Heights Landscaping & Grounds** — *Golf Estate, Port Harcourt* (`Maintenance & Landscaping`)
   - **Scope:** Landscape redesign, automated irrigation overhaul, decorative lawn turfing, and perimeter stormwater drainage maintenance.
   - **Outcome:** Mitigated seasonal waterlogging and elevated residential curb appeal across common estate grounds.

5. **Industrial Logistics Hub Power & Utilities** — *Trans-Amadi Industrial Layout, Port Harcourt* (`Facility Operations`)
   - **Scope:** Coordination and commissioning of backup power distribution, industrial water treatment filtration, and perimeter CCTV monitoring.
   - **Outcome:** Established reliable utility redundancy and HSE-compliant operational protocols for daily logistics operations.

6. **Apex Prime Commercial Complex Advisory** — *Victoria Island, Lagos* (`Consultancy & Valuation`)
   - **Scope:** Market feasibility assessment, rental yield analysis, and physical condition audit coordinated with accredited valuation surveyors.
   - **Outcome:** Delivered comprehensive market-grounded property condition and yield documentation for institutional asset decision-making.

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q: Is Eniolajun Global Integrated Services Ltd registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC)?**
A: Yes. ENIOLAJUN GLOBAL INTEGRATED SERVICES LIMITED is an active, duly incorporated Nigerian corporate entity registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC) as a Private Company Limited by Shares under Registration Number RC 1441429 (verifiable via https://search.cac.gov.ng).

**Q: How quickly can Eniolajun Global commence facility or estate management?**
A: Following an initial on-site physical inspection and agreement on the Scope of Work (SOW), our team can mobilize within 3 to 5 business days with security protocols, technical maintenance schedules, and financial administration structures.

**Q: Do you manage residential estates as well as commercial towers?**
A: Yes. We manage gated residential communities, apartment complexes, multi-tenanted corporate plazas, commercial logistics centers, and retail parks across Nigeria.

**Q: How is service charge collection and accounting handled?**
A: We operate designated transparent client bank accounts with monthly reconciliation. Resident and landlord executives receive itemized balance sheets showing collections, vendor payments, diesel supplies, and contingency reserves.

**Q: How are regulated services such as valuation, legal documentation, and engineering installations handled?**
A: All electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and generator technicians undergo technical competency assessments and background vetting, while statutory valuations, legal lease/title documentation, and specialized engineering sign-offs are formally executed alongside accredited partner Estate Surveyors and Valuers, legal practitioners, and COREN-certified engineers.
